ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to undergraduate Finance majors. Any remaining seats will open to other College of Business students at approximately noon November 25th. Prerequisite FIN 321 will be enforced. Students who have not completed FIN 321 will be removed from the FIN 424. FOR STUDENTS RECEIVING A RESERVED CLOSED ERROR: There are currently reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions at the end of the first week of class on Friday by 10am.
